headline: Meta is bringing its Your Algorithm tool to Facebook, so users can tell the feed which topics they want more or less of.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a change to what a very large social network shows its users, using AI in ranking, but the claims are Meta's own and no rollout detail is given.
importance_line: Facebook users gain a direct say in what their feed and Reels show, which may cut unwanted content, but the real-time result is Meta's own claim and the report gives no rollout date or country list.
summary: The Verge reports that Meta is bringing its Your Algorithm feature, already on Instagram, to Facebook, where users can add and manage topics for their feed and Reels or mark posts "interested" or "not interested". Meta says recommendations "respond right away" and that it is using large language models, the AI systems behind chatbots, more in its ranking so users can state their wishes in their own words; these are Meta's own claims.
notes: Read in full on The Verge. Short article: no launch date, countries or independent test given.
